# Cleveland 1953.24, Coronation of the Virgin leaf

The Coronation of the Virgin and its polychrome floral frame with knotted medallions, from a Tuscan antiphonary leaf painted by the Master of the Beffi Triptych in the 1400s, in the Cleveland Museum of Art.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `cma-1953-24`, historical, 4 assets, version 1.0.0.
